preseason_rankings.title: 26-27 Preseason Rankings
preseason_rankings.heading: 26-27 Preseason Rankings
preseason_rankings.description: D3 WBB preseason rankings: way too early, for the 2026-27 season.

legend.Region: Region is the team's NCAA Division III region, numbered 1 to 10.
legend.Win%: Win% is the team's 2025-26 winning percentage.
legend.SOS: SOS is the team's 2025-26 strength of schedule.
legend.Height: Height is the team's 2025-26 average height, weighted by minutes played.
legend.Returning: Returning is the share of last season's points scored by players on this season's roster.
legend.Projected Preseason Rank: Projected Preseason Rank is the team's projected rank at the start of the 2026-27 season.
legend.Safe Losses Threshold: Safe Losses Threshold is the most losses a team can have and still be safe for NCAA Tournament selection.
legend.Dangerous: Dangerous is the number of losses that puts the team at risk of missing the NCAA Tournament.

returners.title: Returning and Non-Returning
returners.heading: Returning and Non-Returning
returners.description: D3 WBB Returning Minutes for teams with published rosters: underclassmen minutes lost, minutes incoming from D3 transfers, minutes back from fifth-years, and more.

legend.Pub?: Pub? shows whether the team has published its 2026-27 roster.
legend.Surp Gone: Surp Gone is the minutes lost to players who left with eligibility remaining.
legend.Exp Gone: Exp Gone is the minutes lost to players who were expected to leave, such as graduating seniors.
legend.Transfers In: Transfers In is the minutes that incoming D3 transfers played last season.
legend.5th: 5th is the minutes that fifth-year players back for another season played last season.
legend.5th Year Last Names: 5th Year Last Names lists the last names of the fifth-year players on the roster.

npi.title: NPI
npi.heading: NPI
npi.description: D3 WBB NCAA Power Index (NPI): daily values, rankings, and analysis.

legend.NPI Value: NPI Value is the team's current NPI.
legend.Value Old: Value Old is the team's NPI at the previous update.
legend.Value Diff: Value Diff is NPI Value minus Value Old.
legend.NPI Rank: NPI Rank is the team's rank by NPI.
legend.Rank Old: Rank Old is the team's NPI rank at the previous update.
legend.Rank Diff: Rank Diff is the number of places the team moved since the previous update. A positive number means it moved up.
legend.Bid Type: Bid Type is AQ for a projected automatic bid. Otherwise it is AL with the team's place in the at-large order, for example AL-05.
legend.Qual Games: Qual Games is the number of games the NPI counts.
legend.Qual Wins: Qual Wins is the number of wins the NPI counts.
legend.QWB: A win over a team with an NPI above 54.00 earns a Quality Win Bonus (QWB) on top of its Game NPI. The bonus is two thirds of the opponent's NPI above 54.00, so a win over a 60.00 team earns 4.00.
legend.Lowest Counting Win: Lowest Counting Win is the Game NPI of the weakest win the NPI still counts.
legend.Next Game Win NPI: Next Game Win NPI is the Game NPI the team earns if it wins its next game.
legend.Potential Increase: Potential Increase is how much the team's NPI rises if it wins its next game.
legend.Next Game Loss NPI: Next Game Loss NPI is the Game NPI the team earns if it loses its next game.
legend.Rem Games < 50.00 NPI: Rem Games < 50.00 NPI is the number of remaining games against teams with an NPI below 50.00.

season_simulations.title: Season Simulations
season_simulations.heading: Season Simulations
season_simulations.description: D3 WBB season simulations: Efficiency-Rating-based projections of NCAA qualification rates.

legend.MedW: MedW is the team's median number of wins across the simulations.
legend.MedL: MedL is the team's median number of losses across the simulations.
legend.Tourn%: Tourn% is the share of simulations in which the team makes the NCAA Tournament.
legend.AQ%: AQ% is the share of simulations in which the team wins its conference's automatic bid.
legend.At-Large%: At-Large% is the share of simulations in which the team gets an at-large bid.
legend.ALWYNI: ALWYNI (At Large When You Need It): of the simulations where a team doesn't get the automatic bid, the share where it gets an at-large bid
legend.F-AL%: F-AL% is the share of at-large bids in the simulations where the team loses in its conference tournament final.
legend.SF-AL%: SF-AL% is the share of at-large bids in the simulations where the team loses in its conference tournament semifinal.
legend.QF-AL%: QF-AL% is the share of at-large bids in the simulations where the team loses in its conference tournament quarterfinal.
legend.Top4%: Top4% is the share of simulations in which the team finishes in the top 4 of NPI.
legend.Top8%: Top8% is the share of simulations in which the team finishes in the top 8 of NPI.
legend.Top16%: Top16% is the share of simulations in which the team finishes in the top 16 of NPI.
legend.Med-NPI: Med-NPI is the team's median final NPI across the simulations.
legend.Min: Min is the team's lowest final NPI in any simulation.
legend.Max: Max is the team's highest final NPI in any simulation.

current_season_rankings.title: Current Season Rankings
current_season_rankings.heading: Current Season Rankings
current_season_rankings.description: D3 WBB team rankings based on this season's results.

legend.Value of Results: Value of Results is the sum of the team's game values so far. Each game's value comes from the opponent's preseason rank.
legend.TOP 50 W: TOP 50 W is the number of wins over teams ranked in the preseason top 50.
legend.OUT OF TOP 30 L: OUT OF TOP 30 L is the number of losses to teams ranked outside the preseason top 30.
legend.Overall Wins Massey: Overall Wins Massey is the average preseason rank of the teams this team has beaten. A team with no wins gets 450.
legend.Eff: Eff is the team's adjusted efficiency margin (adjEM): how many points per 100 possessions it is better than an average D3 team.
legend.STAT: STAT combines five stats into one score. Each stat is compared with the D3 average and weighted: Eff counts 16, OUT OF TOP 30 L counts 10 against the team, Value of Results counts 5.5, TOP 50 W counts 5, and Overall Wins Massey counts 2 against the team.
legend.STDEV: STDEV is how many standard deviations the team's STAT is above the D3 average. A negative number means below average.

composite_rankings.title: Composite Rankings
composite_rankings.heading: Composite Rankings
composite_rankings.description: D3 WBB team rankings from the median of NPI, Massey, Efficiency, and current-season results.

legend.Region: Region is the team's NCAA Division III region, numbered 1 to 10.
legend.Massey Rank: Massey Rank is the team's rank in the Massey ratings.
legend.Eff Rank: Eff Rank is the team's rank by adjusted efficiency margin (adjEM).
legend.NPI Rank: NPI Rank is the team's rank by NPI.
legend.Curr Season Results Rank: Curr Season Results Rank is the team's Rank on the Current Season Rankings page.
legend.Strength of Record: Strength of Record is the team's rank by SOR, which measures how hard its record is to match against its schedule.
legend.Wins Above Bubble: Wins Above Bubble is the team's rank by WAB: its wins minus the wins a bubble team would expect against its schedule.
legend.Preseason Rank: Preseason Rank is the team's rank before the season started.
legend.MEDIAN: MEDIAN is the median of the team's Massey, Eff, NPI, Curr Season Results, Strength of Record, and Wins Above Bubble ranks. It leaves out Preseason Rank.
legend.OVR_RANK: OVR_RANK orders teams by MEDIAN, lowest first.
legend.Stdev: Stdev is the standard deviation of the team's Massey, Eff, NPI, and Curr Season Results ranks. A high Stdev means those rankings disagree about the team.

conference_rankings.title: Conference Rankings
conference_rankings.heading: Conference Rankings
conference_rankings.description: D3 WBB conference rankings based on non-conference results.

legend.Region: Region is the NCAA Division III region where the conference's teams play.
legend.Win: Win is the number of non-conference games the conference's teams have won.
legend.Loss: Loss is the number of non-conference games the conference's teams have lost.
legend.Win%: Win% is the conference's winning percentage in non-conference games.
legend.Wins: Wins is the average Massey rank of the non-conference opponents the conference's teams have beaten.
legend.STAT: STAT combines two non-conference results into one score: the conference's Win% and Wins, the average Massey rank of the opponents its teams beat.
